verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS memory service with SDKs, a CLI and an open-source framework (Graphiti), so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out setting. The RTBF deletion, audit/API logs and VPC deployment items concern data handling, not telemetry collection, so they cannot be credited here.
